key_insight: EMGKT improves radiology report generation by transferring medical knowledge at multiple granularity levels, combining global context with fine-grained distillation and expert disease classifiers.
clinical_relevance: The approach aims to help models produce more accurate, clinically styled X-ray reports, potentially reducing reporting workload for radiologists.
method: Encodes global medical knowledge embeddings with a vision-language model for contextual understanding.
Uses Fine-Grained Knowledge Distillation to learn student embeddings from teacher embeddings, dropping extra priors at inference for low overhead.
Adds a mixture of disease diagnosis expert classifiers initialized from disease embeddings to capture different feature granularities.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on two widely used public datasets against multiple baselines, and the abstract reports improved effectiveness and transferability.
watch_item: Reported gains depend on dataset quality and integration into existing pipelines; real-world performance may vary across scanners, hospitals, and report styles.
paper_title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
